+---
+- name: install older collections for upgrade tests
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install
+    upgrade_test.parent:1.0.0 upgrade_test.child:1.0.0
+    upgrade_test.stable:1.0.0 namespace1.name1:1.0.0
+    -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_initial
+
+- name: keep installed versions without --upgrade
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install upgrade_test.parent
+    -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_without_flag
+
+- name: assert installed collections are untouched without --upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - '"Nothing to do" in upgrade_without_flag.stdout'
+
+- name: upgrade within a range already satisfied by the installed version
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install 'upgrade_test.parent:<2.0.0'
+    --upgrade -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_constrained
+
+- name: assert upgrade respects the upper bound
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - '"Installing" not in upgrade_constrained.stdout'
+
+- name: upgrade parent and required transitive dependency
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install 'upgrade_test.parent:>=1.0.0,<3.0.0'
+    -U -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_parent
+
+- name: assert only necessary collections were upgraded
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - '"Installing ''upgrade_test.parent:2.0.0''" in upgrade_parent.stdout'
+    - '"Installing ''upgrade_test.child:3.0.0''" in upgrade_parent.stdout'
+    - '"Installing ''upgrade_test.stable" not in upgrade_parent.stdout'
+
+- name: repeat the upgrade
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install upgrade_test.parent
+    --upgrade -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_repeat
+
+- name: assert the repeated upgrade does not reinstall collections
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - '"Installing" not in upgrade_repeat.stdout'
+
+- name: write requirements for upgrade
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: upgrade_test.parent
+          version: '<3.0.0'
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '<1.1.0'
+
+- name: upgrade all collections from a requirements file
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade
+    -r {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml
+    -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_requirements
+
+- name: assert requirements file constraints and idempotency
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - '"Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.0.9''" in upgrade_requirements.stdout'
+    - '"Installing ''upgrade_test.parent" not in upgrade_requirements.stdout'
+
+- name: opt in to prerelease during upgrade
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1
+    --upgrade --pre -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_prerelease
+
+- name: assert prerelease upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - '"Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.1.0-beta.1''" in upgrade_prerelease.stdout'
+
+- name: install older dependencies for no-deps upgrade test
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install
+    upgrade_test.parent:1.0.0 upgrade_test.child:1.0.0
+    upgrade_test.stable:1.0.0
+    -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-no-deps {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+
+- name: reject an upgrade that requires changing dependencies with --no-deps
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install upgrade_test.parent:2.0.0
+    --upgrade --no-deps -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-no-deps {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_no_deps
+  failed_when: false
+
+- name: assert no-deps upgrade fails without changing installed dependencies
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - upgrade_no_deps.rc != 0
+    - '"Could not satisfy" in upgrade_no_deps.stderr'
+    - '"Installing" not in upgrade_no_deps.stdout'
+
+- name: reject an unsatisfiable upgrade with no dependencies
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install 'upgrade_test.parent:>2.0.0'
+    --upgrade --no-deps -p {{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_impossible
+  failed_when: false
+
+- name: assert unsatisfiable constraint fails clearly
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - upgrade_impossible.rc != 0
+    - '"Could not satisfy" in upgrade_impossible.stderr'
